name: update a value toward reward plus discounted best next value
mechanism: keep a table of values per state-action; after each step move the value of the taken pair a fraction toward the observed reward plus the discounted best value available at the next state (or the value of the next action actually taken, for the on-policy variant)

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Q-learning' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: learns an action-value function that gives the expected utility of taking a given action in a given state and following a fixed policy thereafter
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'State–Action–Reward–State–Action (SARSA)': learn a Markov decision process policy
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Temporal difference learning':

requires: a discount and a learning rate (policy)
fails_when: tables do not scale; function approximation loses the guarantee
